title: Takania and Citrusne Stir Fry with Zacepene Sauce
description: Quick and flavorful stir-fry dish served with a tangy zacepene sauce. A great option for those looking for a light and refreshing meal.
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add takania and cook for 3-4 minutes until tender.
In a small bowl, whisk together zacepene juice, soy sauce, and honey.
Pour the zacepene sauce over the takania and stir to coat.
Add citrusne to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes until heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately over rice or noodles.
Garnish with additional citrusne slices if desired.
